name: (04) Assamite Sorcery (Whispers of the Heavens) — 3 Advanced — Ripples on the Sea of Stars

system.description:
The pinnacle of this path lets the sorcerer cast her point of view far from her body, using the heavens as a vast scrying pool, observing any event transpiring under the same stars she can see. She must be familiar with at least one participant in the scene — a place, person, or object.

The scene observed must occur under open night sky visible to the sorcerer; the attempt automatically fails if the events unfold under sunlight or a roof (though the challenge is still made). If the sorcerer has read the target's future before by this or other means, the difficulty is reduced by one Trait. Successes determine clarity and influence: one grants a dim view; two, sight and sound; three, full sensory clarity plus the ability to use Auspex (basic and intermediate) to observe in greater detail; four, the ability to use all Auspex powers on the scene and any other Assamite Sorcery power (not ritual) to observe or analyze it; five, the ability to use any Assamite Sorcery power or ritual that does not require physical presence to affect the scene. The vision lasts until the scene ends or dawn breaks at either location. While active, the player suffers a bonus difficulty Trait on any action requiring interaction with her physical surroundings. A subject with Auspex senses a faint feeling of being watched from above, though not enough to identify the observer.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Two
